privacy.question: Are my memories and family data secure?
privacy.answer: KidMemoir is designed with secure connections, user-level access policies and protected cloud infrastructure. Every family can access only its own private records.

ai.question: Does KidMemoir AI diagnose my child?
ai.answer: No. KidMemoir AI does not provide medical or psychological diagnoses. It only summarizes memories you add, reveals connections and shows the sources it used.

training.question: Is my data used to train AI?
training.answer: No. Your private family records are not used to train general-purpose AI models or build advertising profiles.

free.question: What can I do with the free plan?
free.answer: You can create one child profile, use essential memories, media and timeline features, and access a limited KidMemoir AI experience.

media.question: What kinds of memories can I save?
media.answer: Photos, videos, audio recordings, documents, development notes, important firsts and reminders can all live in the same life story.

export.question: Can I export my memories later?
export.answer: Yes. Your records belong to you. The freedom to export memories and reports in portable formats is one of our core principles.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy | KidMemoir
metadata.description: Learn how KidMemoir handles and protects personal and child data, and understand your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: A clear explanation of why we process data and how we keep you in control.

scope.title: Scope and data responsibility
scope.body1: This policy covers personal data processed through KidMemoir and content parents add on behalf of their children.
scope.body2: KidMemoir follows applicable data protection principles, including lawfulness, transparency, purpose limitation and data minimization, under the GDPR and relevant local requirements.

data.title: Data we use
data.body1: We may process account, profile, child profile, memory and technical usage information to provide the service.
points: Name, email address and account preferences
Basic child profile details supplied by a parent
Memories, dates, notes, photos, videos and audio recordings
Security, session, device and error records
Plan and feature usage information

purposes.title: Purposes of processing
purposes.body1: Data is used to operate accounts, preserve memories securely, apply preferences, maintain security and provide requested support.
purposes.body2: We do not use data to create unrelated advertising profiles without an appropriate legal basis or user choice.

children.title: Special protection for children's data
children.body1: We recognize the sensitivity of children's information. It should only be added by a parent or authorized user with the child's best interests in mind.
points: Child profiles are private by default
Access is restricted through account sessions and row-level security
Parents should avoid unnecessary data and assess sharing carefully
A child's views should be considered when appropriate for their age and maturity

retention.title: Retention
retention.body1: Data is retained while an account is active and as needed to provide the service. Legal obligations, security records or disputes may require longer retention.
retention.body2: After a deletion request, data is removed from active systems; secure backup deletion may take additional time through normal retention cycles.

security.title: Security measures
security.body1: We use technical and organizational measures including access controls, session security, encrypted transfer, private storage and database row-level security.
security.body2: No digital system can guarantee absolute security. Contact us promptly if you identify suspicious activity.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body1: Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to processing and receive a portable copy of your data.
points: Request information about processed data
Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
Request deletion or restriction where applicable
Object depending on the legal basis for processing
Complain to a competent data protection authority

transfers.title: Service providers and transfers
transfers.body1: Infrastructure providers may be used for hosting, authentication, storage and email. They receive data only as needed to provide those services.
transfers.body2: Where international transfers occur, applicable safeguards and contractual protections are assessed.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body1: For privacy requests, contact hello@kidmemoir.com with enough information for us to verify your identity and understand the request.
contact.body2: Requests are reviewed within applicable legal timeframes and security verification requirements.

metadata.title: Terms of Use | KidMemoir
metadata.description: Review KidMemoir service terms, account rules and user responsibilities.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The essential terms for using KidMemoir safely and responsibly.

service.title: Service scope
service.body1: KidMemoir helps families organize childhood memories, media and important dates in a private digital archive.
service.body2: The service may evolve as features develop. Material changes will be communicated through appropriate channels.

accounts.title: Account rules
accounts.body1: You must provide accurate account information, keep credentials confidential and protect activity under your account.
points: A valid email address is required
Accounts must not be shared without authorization
Suspected unauthorized access should be reported
Anyone adding child data must have appropriate parental or representative authority

responsibilities.title: User responsibilities
responsibilities.body1: You are responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of uploaded content and for holding all necessary permissions.
responsibilities.body2: You are expected to consider the child's privacy, best interests and future digital reputation.

prohibited.title: Prohibited uses
prohibited.body1: The service must not be used for unlawful, harmful, abusive purposes or to infringe the rights of others.
points: Unauthorized access or bypassing safeguards
Malware, automated attacks or service disruption
Uploading third-party content without permission
Content that endangers a child's safety or privacy
Fraudulent, deceptive or illegal activity

content.title: User content
content.body1: You retain your rights in your content. You allow us to store, process and display it only as needed to provide features you request.
content.body2: Keeping an appropriate backup copy of important content is recommended.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body1: The KidMemoir brand, software, interface and original service materials are protected by applicable intellectual property rights.
intellectualProperty.body2: Copying, reverse engineering or commercial redistribution without permission is prohibited.

premium.title: Premium service terms
premium.body1: Premium features will be subject to the scope and limits shown on the plan page. Price, renewal, cancellation and refund terms will be shown before purchase when payments launch.
premium.body2: No payment is currently collected and paid subscription processing is not yet available.

availability.title: Service availability
availability.body1: We work to keep the service reliable, but maintenance, security, infrastructure or events outside our control may cause temporary interruptions.
availability.body2: Material planned maintenance will be announced when practical.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body1: KidMemoir is not a medical, legal or professional assessment service. Summaries and future AI outputs do not replace professional advice.
disclaimer.body2: Liability is limited to the extent permitted by applicable law; rights that cannot legally be limited remain unaffected.

termination.title: Suspension and termination
termination.body1: Access may be restricted for serious violations, security risks or legal obligations. Notice and a chance to respond will be provided where appropriate.
termination.body2: Account closure and data rights remain subject to the Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body1: Terms may be updated as the service or law changes. Reasonable notice will be provided before material changes take effect.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body1: Questions about these terms can be sent to hello@kidmemoir.com.
